paragraphs.text: Offline OCR engine extracted from the Windows 11 Snipping Tool, with full-featured C++ CLI, reusable
This repository can be installed as a DeepSeek Harness plugin:
It registers `oneocr_recognize`, a model-facing tool that accepts a local image path and returns rec
ognized text together with OneOCR's structured line/word polygons, confidence values, image angle, a
nd handwriting style. The tool runs locally on Windows 11; image bytes are not sent to an external O
ing style. The tool runs locally on Windows 11; image bytes are not sent to an external OCR service.
The bundle defaults to the prebuilt `bin/ocr.exe` and its adjacent runtime files. Override `ocrBin`,
`timeoutMs`, or `maxOutputBytes` in the plugin row if needed.
| **8-point Bounding Box** | 4-corner polygon bbox for lines and words (not just axis-aligned rect)

|
| **Word Confidence** | Per-word recognition confidence score (0.0–1.0) |
| **Image Angle** | Dete

cted rotation angle of the text in the image |
| **Line Style** | Handwritten vs. printed text class

ification with confidence |
| **Resize Resolution** | Configurable max internal resize before OCR (p

erformance/accuracy trade-off) |
| **Resource Release** | Proper cleanup via `ReleaseOcrResult`, `Re

leaseOcrPipeline`, etc. |
| **Unicode Path** | Full Unicode file path support via `_wfopen` in the D

LL wrapper |
| **Multi-image Batch** | Process multiple images in one invocation |
| **Plain Text Ou

tput** | `--text` mode for pipe-friendly output (no JSON) |
| **Raw Buffer OCR** | `ocrImageRaw()` f

or in-memory BGRA pixel buffers (no file I/O) |
| **Visualization** | Python script with confidence-
colored word boxes and style labels |
Copy these 3 files from the Snipping Tool installation folder into the same directory as `ocr.exe`:

| `--text`, `-t` | Output plain text only (no JSON) |
| `--output`, `-o <file>` | Write JSON to spec
A reusable C DLL wrapper with 3 main APIs:

| `initModel(model_dir)` | Load DLL + model, initialize pipeline |
| `ocrImage(image_path, json, all

oc)` | OCR an image file → JSON string |
| `ocrImageEx(image_path, json, alloc, max_lines, resize_w,

resize_h)` | OCR with configurable options |
| `ocrImageRaw(pixel_data, w, h, step, json, alloc)` |

OCR on raw BGRA pixel buffer |
| `releaseModel()` | Clean up all resources |

Features:
- 8-point polygon bounding boxes (lines in red, words colored by confidence)
- Confidence

score labels below each word
- Handwritten lines highlighted in orange, printed in red
- Image angle

| `oneocr/` | Python | PyPI package with PIL/cv2 input, FastAPI web server |

crates.io library with `image` crate, serde JSON |

output |
| `win11_oneocr_py/` | Python | Basic ctypes script (original Python port) |

with web server
